## Decisions

- **Docs live in docs/; README.md and README_AI_AGENT.md stay at the repo root**: The template already has a docs/ folder and the root stays readable; the gateway links every doc (alternatives: Every file at the repo root)
- **Keep graphify-out/ at the root as engine output; docs/graphify-architecture/ holds curated exports and dated snapshots**: graphify's hooks and CLAUDE.md integration expect graphify-out/ (alternatives: Rename graphify-out to graphify-architecture; Symlink)
- **One JSON file per agent session in agent-history/entries/**: Parallel branches and agents never conflict (alternatives: Single append-only JSONL log; Entries embedded in Markdown)
- **Obsidian sync is one-way from the task list and history into obsidian-out/**: Avoids a second writer to the task list and merge conflicts with agent branches (alternatives: Two-way sync with the Kanban plugin as an editor)
- **Effective roles = direct roles plus roles inherited through groups; RLS reads membership tables, JWT claims only drive the UI**: Revoking a role, group membership or suspending a user takes effect on the next request (alternatives: RLS on JWT claims (up to one token lifetime of staleness))
- **Google integration through one service account; Drive metadata mirrored and files streamed after an RLS check**: No per-user OAuth tokens or Google app verification; our RBAC decides who sees each document (alternatives: Per-user Google OAuth; Drive /preview iframes that bypass our RBAC)
- **PWA scoped to install, Web Push and a notification center start page; no offline data**: Covers the mobile need with little service-worker complexity and keeps email volume low (alternatives: Offline-first PWA; Native mobile app)
